annotations.text: Measured on the running app, not estimated: Playwright at 390x844 with touch emulation, guest planner, two tasks seeded. With seven tasks the Plan tab reached 3,525px.

Today / Focus / Habits / Review is the leading direction, built out across the four screens in the top row.

Each one is sized to exactly 390x844 - if it fits the artboard, it fits the phone with no scrolling.

The desktop screens live in their own canvas.

Two alternates for the Today screen, same IA underneath.

Timeline day: the whole day's shape at a glance, current block expanded in place. Better for schedule-driven days; costs calm, since everything stays visible.

One thing: a single task fills the screen, swipe up for the day. Maximum focus; slower to triage, and you lose the day's shape.
